colors.name: --color-info
colors.value:
... }` perderia
     pra `--color-info: #3b82f6` gerado pelo bloco `@theme` (que vem depois no arquivo e empata em
     especificidade com `.dark`, então venceria por ordem de declaração). No claro é o hex cru
     (--info-active já escurece pra badge "soft", ver comentário abaixo)

colors.name: --nav-c-violet
colors.value:
color-mix(
    in srgb,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--iris) 45%, var(--orbit-blue)) 72%,
    white
  )

colors.name: --nav-c-teal
colors.value: color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 55%, var(--orbit-blue)) 72%, white)

colors.name: --shadow-glow-accent-violet-value
colors.value:
0 0 20px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-violet) 55%, transparent),
    0 0 8px -1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-violet) 40%, transparent)

colors.name: --shadow-glow-accent-cyan-value
colors.value:
0 0 20px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-cyan) 55%, transparent),
    0 0 8px -1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-cyan) 40%, transparent)

shadows.name: --shadow-glow-pulse-value
shadows.value:
0 0 20px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--pulse) 55%, transparent),
    0 0 8px -1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--pulse) 40%, transparent)
